How enjoying things without needing them changes everything.

Kevin Trudeau describes a life with dozens of cars, homes in cities around the world and fine art, all staffed and running at once. When it was all taken away, people asked how he was coping.

His answer: he wasn't attached to any of it. He had simply enjoyed it, and it was someone else's turn.

Which do you do more: enjoy things or need them?
